name: redlinejs
description: Visual website feedback for coding agents: read, reply to and resolve the comments reviewers leave on your live pages, with the exact element attached.

settings.name: Redline Cloud review
settings.description: Optional. A review id (rvw_…) for remote mode. Leave empty to use the local review in your project folder.

settings.name: Redline Cloud agent invite
settings.description: Optional. The review's agent token (agt_…), from the review's Agent tab at app.redlinejs.com. Leave empty for local mode.
